model.name: shifted-mm1-p95-surrogate
model.formula: L_ms(q) = b_ms + 1000*ln(20)*c/(lambda*(q-c)), q>c; no finite stationary prediction for q<=c. Effective service demand d=c/lambda.
model.fit: Search c at positive multiples of 0.0005 below every exact-quantile calibration quota, and b at integer milliseconds from 0 through floor(minimum exact p95). Minimize sum of squared log residuals of exact p95 observations plus squared one-sided log deficits for right-censored p95 lower bounds. Use every post-warmup calibration window. Ties resolve to smaller c, then smaller b. No model selection on validation data.
model.error_guard: In addition to the p95 model, forbid quotas at or below the largest calibration quota with error fraction >=0.01. This is an explicit empirical guard, not an error-probability model. New validation failures still count against an allowed transfer.
model.limitations: A two-parameter queue-inspired surrogate, not an exact microservice queueing network. Constant-rate arrivals, periodic CPU throttling, variable downstream delays, failures and runtime state violate ideal M/M/1 assumptions. Model adequacy is the object of this test. No confidence bound or reliability guarantee is inferred.

freeze: Five fixed-quota calibrations each use a fresh stack and fresh volumes on the same runner; their order is fixed by SHA256. Save calibration hashes, fitted parameters, crossing and all planned predictions, then upload the frozen forecast artifact BEFORE starting the independent fresh-stack validation. Never update parameters, recommendation or trajectory using validation outcomes.
validation: Start at 0.30 checkout CPU. Keep checkout+ad=0.70 and total CPU ceilings=3.4; other CPU and RAM limits stay fixed. Freeze the union of the original coarse grid and every 0.001-CPU point within recommendation +/-0.020 CPU, clipped to 0.08--0.30. If there is no in-range recommendation, execute only the coarse grid for diagnostics. Workload remains 40 checkout operations/s and 100 ad requests/s. The first intervention is at load age 270 s; subsequent interventions are 90 s apart. Each primary cohort begins 10 s after the update and lasts 60 s. Continue the frozen path; primary analysis ends at the first unsafe primary cohort.
scope_gate: The fresh validation baseline must meet checkout SLO. This is not a claim that advertising or all system requirements are met. Unsafe baselines and model abstentions remain visible, are not infrastructure failures and are not retried for outcome selection.
primary: Among technically valid validations with a checkout-safe baseline and an in-range recommendation, count any first observed unsafe point that the frozen model/guard permitted. Report the exact numerator and denominator, no binary campaign success threshold. Unknown/unobserved intervals are not certified safe.
boundary_accuracy: Report the last-safe/first-unsafe sampled bracket, its actual width, continuous predicted boundary and executable recommendation separately. Declare fine resolution only if BOTH bracket endpoints lie within the frozen fine band and their difference is at most 0.001 CPU. Crossings outside the band retain their coarse width; no crossing is censored. These are sampled history-dependent transitions, not a certified continuous deterministic boundary.
coda: Use the complete eleven-part CPU composition and an orthonormal Helmert ILR basis. Check the boundary again by evaluating the SAME physical additive checkout-to-ad path through ILR and inverse ILR. The path is generally curved in ILR; report endpoint Aitchison distance separately from relative arc length along that curve. Absolute budgets remain explicit. Coordinate equality is a numerical check, not an empirical advantage claim.
timeouts: Keep all timeout/failed/unfinished operations in SLO outcomes. Record k6 error_code=1050. A calibration p95 whose order-statistic interpolation touches a timed-out or missing response is a lower bound, not an exact response time; retain its one-sided loss. Do not remove slow observations or fit deadlines as exact successful completions.
quality: Preserve pinned images/actions, rendered Compose, host diagnostics, cgroup CPU period 100000 us, all quota readbacks, constant-rate delivery, primary event/counter agreement and failure events. Restart/OOM never changes SLO labels or automatically excludes observations. Missing primary records or generator failure is infrastructure-invalid; completed load/quota/timing mismatches are reported separately.
retry: Retry only infrastructure-failed runner blocks. A retry repeats calibration AND validation; never combine stages from different attempts. Aggregate the latest whole attempt irrespective of outcomes, retaining attempt statuses.
amendment: Use the independently checked cgroupfs driver for exact thousandth-CPU limits. Repeat all six whole runner blocks, retaining the same calibration, model, workload, primary checkout requirements and observation timings. Add a deterministic 0.001-CPU band extending 0.020 CPU to each side of the frozen executable recommendation, clipped to 0.08--0.30. Retain the coarse grid outside that band. Slower physical adaptation within the band changes the history; do not pool this campaign with earlier campaigns.
quota_preflight: Each runner selects cgroupfs BEFORE creating experimental containers. Require recorded docker info to confirm the driver. Test all 221 checkout/ad pairs 0.300/0.400 down to 0.080/0.620 with a 0.001-CPU increment, read back actual cpu.max with a 100000-us period, then remove the idle test containers. A mismatch aborts before workload. Every experimental-stack initial and intervention readback remains mandatory.
secondary_analysis: Keep the original 500-ms primary outcome. For the same frozen model and measured history, report first sampled crossing and model permission at each fixed latency limit 300, 400, 500, 600, 750 and 1000 ms, retaining the checkout error rule <1%. Report eligible and observed-crossing counts and censored cases; do not select a new success criterion. Retain 10-second operation-start cohorts over the entire validation as descriptive dynamics; overlapping calibration/primary observations are not independent replications. Report measured margins to checkout p95<=500 ms, checkout errors<1%, and >=99% of advertising attempts timely within 200 ms. Advertising is a separate descriptive requirement and does not redefine primary eligibility. This series does not measure accounting timeliness.
execution_budget: Six runner jobs run in parallel, each with a 180-minute cap. The band contains at most 41 fine points plus the coarse grid; validation lasts less than 90 minutes. Allow approximately two hours for calibration, validation, resets and artifact handling.
